records.key: Connected mycelial filaments grow from common origins, with wandering tips and recursively branching fronts. Older trails fade as new colonies begin.
records.source: Connected mycelial filaments grow from common origins, with wandering tips and recursively branching fronts. Older trails fade as new colonies begin.
records.translation: Samtengdir sveppþræðir vaxa frá sameiginlegum upphafsstöðum, með ráfandi oddum og vaxtarfröntum sem greinast endurtekið. Eldri slóðir dofna þegar nýjar þyrpingar byrja að vaxa.
